verdicts.reason: Both break the original's banded-ribbon title: 'NEW YORK' is pulled out of its navy ribbon and set loose on the busy photo, an empty navy bar sits above it, the SUBWAY/GUIDE ribbons are shrunk to small secondary chips, and the grey diagonal stripes are left as stray fragments mid-canvas, with the bottom 60% just cropped photo. A sits higher, its white headline is on a darker part of the photo, and it reads a little more cleanly. B pushes the title down onto lighter, busier sign lettering, which weakens contrast and leaves a muddier top area.
